sourceInvestigationAtBaseline.reason2_siteModelHardcode: site-model.ts:658-660 (composeSitePlanModel): for printedBuildable.kind==='refused' when buildableVocab.kind is 'buildable-with-area' or 'provisional' (a LOCAL figure was computed but no buildable-envelope atom backs it), the code hardcodes 'pending -- buildable-envelope atom not yet on file' INSTEAD of buildableVocab.pdfLabel, because pdfLabel for those two kinds literally IS the raw figure (formatSqFt/formatPct) -- printing it here would leak the exact number R-2 (ENVELOPE DRAWN, FIGURE REFUSED) requires withheld. Naive literal compliance with the dispatch text ('reads pdfLabel from the vocabulary') by simply substituting buildableVocab.pdfLabel would REINTRODUCE an R-2 violation -- flagging this now as a real tension the dispatch text does not resolve. Planned resolution: replace the hardcoded literal with envelopeHuman('atom_path_pending') (the SAME atom-contract function, called with the token that actually describes this situation -- setbacks/geometry present, buildable atom not yet minted), which returns 'Withheld, setbacks unruled' -- the IDENTICAL string the MCP already prints for this exact disposition per the wave-4 observation on 48453:367134. This is genuinely vocabulary-sourced (no hardcoded literal survives), carries no raw figure (R-2-safe), and converges PDF wording onto the MCP's existing wording rather than inventing a fourth string. Existing tests author.test.ts:292,350 assert the OLD literal substring and will be updated to assert the new one; this is a considered wording change, not a check being widened to admit a bad value.
